notes.title: Apply For The Baseless Closed Beta!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43250311/3edd5b25ad99a97782e2a5a8b47988ab2572dea4.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We are now accepting applications to be a Closed Beta Tester for our upcoming game Baseless! Have a voice in helping make Baseless the best game possible![/p][p][/p][p]Watch the trailer:[/p][previewyoutube="w0UM48oOPFw;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Please apply using the [url="https://bit.ly/4kMp76P"]link below[/url]. Submissions close on Sunday, June 22nd at 11:59 PM PST. If accepted, the Closed Beta Test will begin on June 23rd at 10AM PST, and conclude in exactly one week on June 30th at 10AM PST. [/p][p][/p][p]Closed Beta Testers will have the opportunity to get their names in the credits![/p][p][/p][p][url="https://bit.ly/4kMp76P" style="button"]Closed Beta Application[/url][/p]

notes.title: PLAY THE DEMO NOW!
notes.notes: [p]That's right, [i]Baseless[/i] is part of [b]Steam Next Fest[/b], running from [b]today until June 16th at 10AM[/b]![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43250311/a55c816681bbbbe837009d978d2736873f34a78c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]That means you can now [b]download and play our official demo[/b], and finally get a hands-on feel of the world of Baseless![/p][p][/p][p]We can't wait for you to jump in and tell us what [b]you[/b] think. Please leave any feedback in the Demo Feedback Thread![/p][p][/p][p]Check out the trailer here: [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/FGSh4B74N9w"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]From the bottom of our hearts, we want to thank all of you for the support! [/p][p]- Fermenter Games and First Break Labs[/p][p] [/p]

notes.title: We Are In The June Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes: [h1]Baseless is headed to Steam Next Fest![/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43250311/57f6c5a784058bf34e51e3a4bde00b64a8df10c4.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]That's right, [i]Baseless[/i] will be part of [b]Steam Next Fest[/b], running from [b]June 9th through June 16th[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]That means you'll be able to [b]download and play our official demo[/b], get a hands-on feel for the gameplay, and experience the breathtaking first zones of Baseless. [/p][p][/p][p]Whether you're here for the Shooting = Movement mechanic, the plethora of vibrant and unique zones, or the satisfaction of decimating every enemy in your path, we can't wait for you to jump in and tell us what [b]you[/b] think of Baseless.[/p][p][/p][p]👉 Make sure to [b]Wishlist[/b] [i]Baseless[/i] so you don’t miss the demo drop![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1129260/Baseless/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Thanks for all your support—and see you during Next Fest![/p][p]- Fermenter Games and First Break Labs[/p]
